title: Create accessibility playbook and remediation plan for compact action pills, tokens, and modal focus
creator: Ava Chen
description: Audit and remediate accessibility gaps for the compact action pill component family and related token surface (contrast tokens, disabled states, focus rings) and produce a reusable playbook and VPAT evidence package. Scope: compact and dense variants of pills, inline action buttons, small table row actions, and modal focus behavior when those controls appear. Deliverables: 1) remediation checklist and actionable token mappings, 2) design + CSS examples and code snippets for focus/hover/pressed states, 3) regression test harness (Cypress + a11y snapshot tests), 4) VPAT evidence document with pass/fail artifacts and repro steps.
acceptance_criteria: All compact pill and small-action variants meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast for normal and hover states (>=4.5:1 text where applicable)
Focusable controls have visible, consistent focus rings that respect compact density without overlapping adjacent elements
Keyboard navigation order is deterministic for pills inside inline flows and within modals; escape and tabbing behavior documented
Token migration guide created: mapping from legacy tokens to new contrast ramp and density tokens
VPAT evidence doc includes screen reader transcripts (NVDA/VoiceOver), keyboard walkthrough recordings, and test harness output
Design and engineering sign-off recorded; at least one partner product team validation completed
progress_updates: 2026-02-15: Initial exploratory audit complete. Logged ~24 unique variations across components (primary/secondary/ghost/disabled) and 3 modal focus patterns. Spreadsheet added to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-playbook-audit

2026-02-22: Proposed contrast ramp (compact-ramp-v2) drafted and reviewed with UX writing; change increases contrast for ghost pills on light backgrounds. Spec: https://confluence.company.com/display/DS/compact-ramp-v2
2026-02-28: Design token PR opened to update --color-pill-ghost-text and --color-pill-border. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design-system/pull/1847
2026-03-05: Engineering feasibility review: Mateo confirmed focus-trap rehydration in the modal library can be adjusted without runtime changes; estimate 3 days of dev effort for migration and tests
2026-03-10: Built cypress a11y test harness; baseline tests show two failing cases for disabled contrast and keyboard focus overlap on 320px width. Tickets created for fixes: ENG-3455, ENG-3456
2026-03-14: PM review complete; accepted playbook outline. Starting design handoff and writing VPAT evidence draft
design_notes: Prefer a 2px focus ring for compact density to avoid visual crowding; ring color to be derived from token --focus-ink with higher contrast on light backgrounds
For ghost pills, increase background delta by 8% to achieve target 4.5:1 for label text; avoid raising border thickness which breaks compact rhythm
Disabled state should use a desaturated token with a minimum contrast of 3:1 against surface for non-text UI per updated DS guidelines; document exception cases
Modal focus rehydration: keep active element idempotent across unmount/mount sequences; provide a small util in modal wrapper to restore focus context
review_feedback: PM (Riley Gomes): Good to prioritize keyboard order for product A since their onboarding flow uses pill filters extensively. Asked to add acceptance test for product A flow
Engineering (Samir Khan): Suggest implementing token aliasing instead of direct replacement to ease the rollout for Dedicated customers; created ENG-3457 to track alias layer
Accessibility consultant (external): Recommend screen reader examples for collapsed pill groups and an ARIA live-region pattern for dynamic counts
qa_checks: Run cypress a11y suite on macOS + VoiceOver and Windows + NVDA; attach full test output to VPAT evidence
Manual keyboard walkthrough on iPhone Safari and Android TalkBack for focus trap in new modal pattern
Contrast verification with axe-core and color-contrast analyzer for all token permutations
Visual regression snapshots for compact density at 320px, 375px, 768px, and 1024px widths
next_steps: Finish token alias PR and coordinate with runtime owners for opt-in migration (ENG-3457)
Resolve failing a11y tests (ENG-3455, ENG-3456) and re-run harness
Produce VPAT evidence package and circulate for legal/compliance review
Schedule product validations with two partner teams (Product A, Product C) before release
